import chess

# Set up the position from the image
# White: King g1, Queen d7, Rook a5, Bishop a3, Knight h4, Pawns f2, g2, h2
# Black: King g8, Queen g6, Knight b7, Bishop g3, Pawns f7, g7, h7
# White to move

fen = "7k/5ppp/1n6/3Q4/8/6b1/r1B3N1/5K2 w - - 0 1"
# Let me verify this FEN
board = chess.Board(fen)
print(board)
print("\nWhite to move:", board.turn == chess.WHITE)
print("Legal moves:", list(board.legal_moves))

# Check for checkmates
for move in board.legal_moves:
    board.push(move)
    if board.is_checkmate():
        print(f"Checkmate move: {board.san(move)}")
    board.pop()
